text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's foreign minister says "traitor" Jalal Talabani has caused difficulties for Kurds.
- Trade minister says truck trade between Iraq and Turkey has resumed.
- Europe expresses support for implementing oil-for-food deal Iraq signed with U.N.
- Editorial welcoming Russian stand against recent U.S. missile attacks on southern Iraq.
(Above stories except editorial also appeared in Qadissiya and Thawra)
- U.S. hostile act and its isolation (editorial).
